protocol: M145 single generated paired efficacy screen

network_law.weight_law: independent N(0,2/256) entries generated by NumPy PCG64 from network_seed
network_law.exclusions: none after generation; a malformed network invalidates the entire screen

truth_source.independence: truth is generated and hash-sealed in a separate process before either estimator runs; estimator processes cannot read its RNG state
truth_source.primary: stream 1,000,000,000 independent antithetic Gaussian paths in float64 using truth_primary_seed; accumulate each output with pairwise float64 reduction
truth_source.audit: stream an independent 1,000,000,000 antithetic Gaussian paths using truth_audit_seed
truth_source.acceptance: primary/audit per-network RMS disagreement must be <= 7.5e-5 and maximum-output disagreement <= 3.0e-4; otherwise the complete screen is invalid and cannot be interpreted
truth_source.stored_record: float64 256-vector plus path count, both RNG seeds, generator/runtime versions, and SHA-256

common_random_coupling.rule: for every row, MatchedComparator and Estimator use the same setup_seed and identical provisional radius-scaled raw-QR frame bank
common_random_coupling.required_check: the two provisional bank SHA-256 values and the independent generator SHA-256 must be identical before prediction
common_random_coupling.candidate: copy the identical bank, run the frozen pilot proposal, reflect only main frames, then restore/canonicalize
common_random_coupling.network_and_truth: both estimators use the same generated network and sealed truth vector
common_random_coupling.forbidden: different setup orientations, seed replacement, network filtering, proposal refit, or parameter selection

subprocess_protocol.affinity: one core, same evaluator image and FlopScope version for every process
subprocess_protocol.score_run: one fresh comparator process and one fresh candidate process per network; order alternates by index parity
subprocess_protocol.replay_run: a second fresh process for both estimators on every network; predictions and billed FLOPs must replay bit-for-bit
subprocess_protocol.timing_record: retain setup, prediction wall, FlopScope backend/overhead/residual, effective compute, matmul calls, working-set peak, and failure status for all 96 processes
subprocess_protocol.tail_adjudication: any process over 258.4B protected C, 20 s predict, 4 s setup, or 512 MiB peak kills M145; no trimming or retry substitution
subprocess_protocol.failure_adjudication: any exception, nonfinite output, weight-envelope violation, seed/hash mismatch, replay mismatch, or truth disagreement kills M145

score_definition.per_network_raw: mean squared error over all 256 final outputs against the pre-sealed truth
score_definition.per_network_adjusted: raw * max(0.1, effective_compute/2.72e11), using the evaluator's official failure fallback
score_definition.configuration_guard: if the deployed evaluator multiplier differs from max(0.1,C/B), execution remains blocked until the protocol is re-audited; do not reinterpret results post hoc

bootstrap.statistic: ratio of the mean candidate adjusted score to the mean comparator adjusted score; never mean of per-network ratios
bootstrap.resampling: sample 24 paired network indices with replacement for every replicate
bootstrap.zero_and_dead_handling: retain every network and all 256 outputs; no dead-output removal. If a bootstrap denominator is exactly zero, that replicate is +infinity and M145 cannot promote
bootstrap.absolute_bound: bootstrap candidate mean adjusted score with the same resampled indices

promote_only_if_all: candidate adjusted-score upper-90 < 2.05e-7 sealed M71 proxy
zero failures and every resource/replay/truth/coupling gate passes
predeclared_decision.otherwise: retain as failed or ambiguous component; do not mutate or rerun for promotion

firewall: No truth generation, MSE, score, outcome, contest row, submission, designation, or champion mutation is authorized by this file.
